subject.title: [codex] fix(feishu): preserve post markdown line breaks

question: Which branch should be the canonical fix for the Feishu post+md single-newline rendering bug after live proof and conflict resolution?
rationale: This PR is a plausible fix but remains draft, dirty, and proof-limited while multiple sibling PRs close the same open issue; automation should not choose the permanent Feishu branch shape for maintainers.

options.title: Use a proof-positive canonical branch
